description: Opsfleet | AI Engineer (Agentic / GenAI) | REMOTE (EEA) | Full-time Fully remote cloud & AI services company (founded 2015, 70+ engineers, AWS Premier, Google Cloud & Snowflake Partner) with a growing GenAI practice and several active client projects. You'll build production LLM agents for clients: multi-agent systems, tool use and RAG, in Python, on AWS Bedrock and GCP Vertex AI. Direct client contact. We're looking for a hands-on engineer (not a research or prompt-only role) who has built and shipped LLM agents to production, with frameworks like Strands Agents, LangChain, Agno, Deep Agents, Google ADK or Claude Agent SDK. Just as important: we hire good people. Communicative, collaborative, eager to learn and happy to take ownership. That's what makes people succeed here, with clients and with the team. Process: intro call -> take-home assignment -> technical interview -> offer. Apply: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4478769287/ or hiring@opsfleet.com, please mention HN
